question: Who was the secretary of UNO between the year 1997-2006?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kofi Annan**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Kofi Annan**
 
• Kofi Annan, a diplomat from Ghana, served as the Secretary-General from 1997 to 2006.
 
 
• He was the first person from sub-Saharan Africa to hold this position.
 
• Annan focused on human rights, sustainable development, and the fight against HIV/AIDS, and he was awarded the Nobel Peace Prize in 2001 for his efforts
